name: Bitypay Visa Infinite Card
summary: A premium self-custody Visa Infinite card allowing users to spend USDC and USDT directly from a non-custodial smart contract wallet.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the Bitypay Visa Infinite Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Bitypay Visa Infinite Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Bitypay Visa Infinite Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
